owner_todos.title: Turn on 2-Step Verification on the Google account that owns Sneaky Deals
owner_todos.why: Required to join the YouTube Partner Program.
owner_todos.how: Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > Turn on.

owner_todos.title: Verify the channel with your phone (advanced features)
owner_todos.why: Required for YPP, and YouTube only keeps our custom Shorts thumbnails on verified channels.
owner_todos.how: Open the link, choose Sneaky Deals, enter your phone number, type the code.

owner_todos.title: Turn on 'Get notified' in YouTube Studio > Earn
owner_todos.why: YouTube emails you the day the channel qualifies, so we apply on day one.

owner_todos.title: Write the channel About section
owner_todos.why: Reviewers read it to judge the channel's theme and originality.
owner_todos.how: Studio > Customisation > Profile > Description. Suggested: 'True stories behind the world's sneakiest business deals, told as one-minute mini-movies. Every story is fact-checked with at least two sources (listed in each description). Scenes are dramatised illustrations; the facts are real. New sneaky deal every day.'

owner_todos.title: Set the channel's country of residence correctly
owner_todos.why: YPP is only available in supported countries and payments depend on it.
owner_todos.how: Studio > Settings > Channel > Basic info > Country of residence.

owner_todos.title: Check there are no Community Guidelines strikes or copyright claims
owner_todos.why: Channels with active strikes cannot apply.
owner_todos.how: Studio > Dashboard and Content > Restrictions column. Tell Claude if anything shows up.

owner_todos.title: Never buy views/subscribers or join sub4sub / engagement groups
owner_todos.why: Fake engagement gets earnings withheld or the channel removed, on all your channels.
owner_todos.how: Nothing to click: just never do it. Mark done once read.
